
== Japanese original printing source audit ==
Original Japanese source: encyclopedia p. 41, embedded JPEG xref 2030. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Image SHA256 <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">86e59005f065042781af37a0c4d53238bb941343ad04fb35c42ccff3f15e78d0</code>. The original image is [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Darth-Vader-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg]]. Printed wraps joined; ASCII digits, Latin letters, +, =, < and > normalized. Unique asterisk tracked separately; Tarkin lore underline retained. Original JPEG remains typography authority. The Japanese game text explicitly explains that the +1 applies to each battle-destiny draw rather than the total and says it may be added; the original English says "adds 1 to each battle destiny." The Japanese condition for the larger [[Vader's Custom TIE]] bonuses says "aboard" (乗っている), while the English says "when piloting." The Japanese lore uses "pilot" and a present-tense description, where the English says "Was the best starpilot in the galaxy." Printed absence is separate from rule-derived defaults and unknown data. No artist/translator credit is visible. Performer likeness attribution and Japanese GEMP implementation remain unresolved. The November 1998 tournament-language rule is dated context, not evidence of earlier or custom-format mechanics. No new rules or implementation equivalence is claimed.
